topic.title: Is an FD really the safest place for ₹5 lakh over 10 years

title: Fixed deposit or index fund: what is the real trade-off?
description: ₹5 lakh for 10 years: a fixed deposit at 7% against an index fund at 10%. Both are assumptions, pre-tax, and index returns are not assured. Illustrative only. Not financial advice.
